title: 12th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/12/2/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 6/2/2025 to 8/2/2025).
First reading of the government-sponsored Public Referendum Bill (on holding public votes to seek the people's opinion), submitted by Inguraidhoo MP Ibrahim Falah.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the government-sponsored bill, submitted by Thinadhoo North MP Saudhulla Hilmy, to amend Law No. 13/2010 (Judges Act).
Report of the State-Owned Enterprises Committee on the state of Maldives Marketing and Public Relations Corporation Ltd (MMPRC) and Maldives Integrated Tourism Development Corporation Ltd (MITDC).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve old minutes, introduce the Public Referendum Bill, continue debating the Judges Act amendment bill, and take up the committee report on MMPRC and MITDC.
